diagnostic_scripts.build_diagnostic.py:
"""Build a local CLI with full-FP32 target/predictor trace capture."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/ifioravanti/github/ds4')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src = (ROOT / 'ds4.c').read_text()
helper = r'''
static void qwen4_round3_dump(uint32_t kind, uint32_t pos, uint32_t rows, const float *logits) {
    const char *path = getenv("DS4_ROUND3_LOGITS");
    if (!path || !logits) return;
    static FILE *fp;
    if (!fp) fp = fopen(path, "wb");
    const uint32_t header[] = {kind, pos, rows, DS4_N_VOCAB};
    if (!fp || fwrite(header, sizeof(header), 1, fp) != 1 ||
        fwrite(logits, sizeof(float), (size_t)rows * DS4_N_VOCAB, fp) != (size_t)rows * DS4_N_VOCAB ||
        fflush(fp) != 0) { fprintf(stderr, "round3 logit dump failed\n"); abort(); }
}
'''
anchor = 'static bool qwen4_graph_forward_tokens('
assert src.count(anchor) == 1
src = src.replace(anchor, helper + '\n' + anchor)
anchor = '    if (ok) g->pos += T;\n'
assert src.count(anchor) == 1
src = src.replace(anchor, '    if (ok && logits_out) qwen4_round3_dump(0, pos0, all_rows ? T : 1u, logits_out);\n' + anchor)
anchor = '        if (ok && draft_out) *draft_out = sample_argmax(dst, DS4_N_VOCAB);\n'
assert src.count(anchor) == 1
src = src.replace(anchor, '        if (ok) qwen4_round3_dump(1, idx, 1u, dst);\n' + anchor)
(OUT / 'ds4_diag.c').write_text(src)
cmd = ['cc', '-O3', '-ffast-math', '-g', '-mcpu=native', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-std=c99', '-I.',
       '-c', str(OUT / 'ds4_diag.c'), '-o', str(OUT / 'ds4_diag.o')]
subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, check=True)
objects = ['ds4_cli.o', 'ds4_help.o', 'ds4_gpu_args.o', 'ds4_prompt_prefix.o', 'linenoise.o',
           'ds4_image.o', 'ds4_distributed.o', 'ds4_tp.o', 'ds4_ssd.o', 'ds4_metal.o', 'ds4_layer_pack.o']
link = ['cc', '-o', str(OUT / 'ds4-diag'), str(OUT / 'ds4_diag.o'), *objects,
        '-lm', '-pthread', '-framework', 'Foundation', '-framework', 'Metal']
subprocess.run(link, cwd=ROOT, check=True)
manifest = {'compile': cmd, 'link': link, 'sha256': {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in [OUT/'ds4_diag.c', OUT/'ds4-diag', ROOT/'ds4.c', ROOT/'ds4_metal.m']}}
(OUT/'diagnostic-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)+'\n')

import subprocess,pathlib,os,json,hashlib,struct,array,math,re
p=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/q2-mtp')
base=['-m','/Users/ifioravanti/models/qwen38-q2down-experiment/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ2XXSImatrix-Q2KDownPad768-MTP.gguf','--ple','/Users/ifioravanti/models/qwen38-q4k-imatrix/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-PLE-Q4_1.gguf','--metal','-c','16384','--nothink','--mtp','--mtp-timing']
prompt=['-p','Explain how a computer sends a web request over TCP and receives the response. Write four clear paragraphs for a programmer learning networking.']
cases={'greedy':[*prompt,'-n','128','--temp','0'], 'exact':[*prompt,'-n','128','--temp','0.7','--top-p','0.8','--seed','123','--mtp-exact-sampling'], 'long': ['--prompt-file','/private/tmp/q2-speed/prompt.txt','-n','64','--temp','0']}
for n in [1,2,3]: cases[f'budget{n}']=[*prompt,'-n',str(n),'--temp','0']
report={'cases':{},'commands':[]}
for case,opts in cases.items():
 records=[]
 for cfg in ['baseline','candidate']:
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('DS4_')}
  trace=p/f'{case}-{cfg}.f32';env['DS4_ROUND3_LOGITS']=str(trace);env['DS4_QWEN4_SPEC_TRACE']='1'
  cmd=[str(p/('ds4-diag-base' if cfg=='baseline' else 'ds4-diag')),*base,*opts]
  report['commands'].append(cmd)
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,check=True)
  (p/f'{case}-{cfg}.log').write_bytes(r.stderr);(p/f'{case}-{cfg}.stdout').write_bytes(r.stdout)
  counters=re.findall(rb'([0-9]+) verify cycles, ([0-9]+) drafts accepted',r.stderr)
  b=trace.read_bytes();offset=0;vectors=0; kinds={}
  while offset<len(b):
   kind,pos,rows,vocab=struct.unpack_from('<4I',b,offset);offset+=16
   n=rows*vocab; floats=array.array('f');floats.frombytes(b[offset:offset+4*n]);offset+=4*n
   assert len(floats)==n and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in floats)
   vectors+=rows;kinds[kind]=kinds.get(kind,0)+rows
  assert offset==len(b)
  records.append({'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'logits_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'vectors':vectors,'kinds':kinds,'accepted':[[int(a),int(c)] for a,c in counters],'trace_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'\n'.join(x for x in r.stderr.splitlines() if x.startswith(b'ds4: spec pos'))).hexdigest()})
 assert records[0]==records[1],(case,records)
 report['cases'][case]=records[0];print(case,records[0],flush=True)
report['source_sha256']={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in [p/'ds4_diag.c',p/'baseline-host.m',pathlib.Path('ds4_metal.m'),p/'ds4-diag',p/'ds4-diag-base']}
(p/'diagnostics.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
